content:
Apple is expected to hold multiple new product launch events next week on October 13, with product launches taking the form of "events," according to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman. Here's what he revealed.

Gurman says Apple will announce three new products at its October 13 event

It's been almost a month since Apple's last launch event, which saw the introduction of the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Duo, and more.

However, it looks like the October launch event could take place as early as next Tuesday (October 13).

Gurman had previously reported that the three products would launch on October 13, but at the time he didn't mention whether a launch event would be held.

There's been plenty of speculation about whether these new Home products warrant their own dedicated event. John Gruber, for example, said the rumored HomePad "absolutely cannot" be announced via press release alone. He wrote: "If this product actually launches, it has to be unveiled with a keynote video, some kind of media event, and hands-on time."

From Gurman's latest newsletter, it's clear he agrees with this approach. The phrase "Apple is planning to hold an event on October 13" sounds pretty straightforward.

If the event does take place, media invitations are expected to go out within the next day or two. Unless, of course, new CEO John Ternus plans to change how products are unveiled and break from past precedent.

Do you think Apple's Home devices will get a proper October event, or will they be announced via press release alone? Let us know in the comments.
